## Get data




```{r}

# https://github.us-bea/bea.R
# library(bea.R)
# beaParams(Sys.getenv("BEA_API_KEY"), 'RegionalData')

zfname <- "SAINC.zip"
fname <- "SAINC4_NY_1929_2024.csv"
zpath <- fs::path(DBEA, zfname)

df <- vroom::vroom(unz(zpath, fname), col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
glimpse(df)
skimr::skim_without_charts(df)

df2 <- df |>
  rename_with(tolower) |>
  filter(!is.na(geoname)) |>
  select(-c(region, tablename, industryclassification))

df3 <- df2 |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c("1929":"2024"), names_to = "year", values_to = "value")

```
